question: What enables the vision of the full state as the manifested essence of the supreme milk-ocean?
premises: A full state is to be seen
That state is revealed as supreme essence
The essence is likened to the milk-ocean
inference: The full state is realized as the manifested essence of the supreme milk-ocean.
uncertainties: Subject who sees is implied but not explicit
plain_english: He, in whom the essence of the supreme milk-ocean is manifested, is able to see the full state.
